vibe_rationale: Women's surf community with free talks, films and music, but run by the sport's governing body with an insurer's naming rights, so more sponsor-branded than SURPLUS.
fit_notes: Women's surf and wellbeing angle (confidence, recovery, hydration) with non-endemic precedent (NRMA Insurance, Sodii Hydration); families attend, so age is mixed. NRMA's naming runs to 2028, so High Ground would need a programme or category role beneath it; it is an NSW event, so direct activation is possible.
